gleam.name: Gleam
gleam.desc: A cold flash from the living flame.

lantern_veil.name: Lantern Veil
lantern_veil.desc: Light bunches into a shielding flare.

spark_pinch.name: Spark Pinch
spark_pinch.desc: A needle of heat nipped from the wick.

ember_sip.name: Ember Sip
ember_sip.desc: Drinks a spark and coughs it back.

soot_cloud.name: Soot Cloud
soot_cloud.desc: A breath of cinder-dark that stings the eyes.

rivet.name: Rivet
rivet.desc: Drives a nail-head into the foe.

shell_grind.name: Shell Grind
shell_grind.desc: Scrapes cobble against cobble until something yields.

burden.name: Burden
burden.desc: Drops the weight of a wall on the target.

file_bite.name: File Bite
file_bite.desc: Chews with a metal mouth and spatters filings.

wire_snap.name: Wire Snap
wire_snap.desc: A taut filament loosed like a whip.

thorn_shot.name: Thorn Shot
thorn_shot.desc: A barb loosed from the hull.

root_tether.name: Root Tether
root_tether.desc: Toes of root snare and squeeze.

leaf_gnash.name: Leaf Gnash
leaf_gnash.desc: Green edges saw at the wound.

bone_hoot.name: Bone Hoot
bone_hoot.desc: A hollow call that rattles the marrow.

shadow_stoop.name: Shadow Stoop
shadow_stoop.desc: Drops from a hush that was not there a breath ago.

shroud_creep.name: Shroud Creep
shroud_creep.desc: Darkness peels off the wall and wraps the foe.

peel_light.name: Peel Light
peel_light.desc: Strips the lantern-glow and feeds on it.

pouch_slap.name: Pouch Slap
pouch_slap.desc: The seawater pouch swings like a wet fist.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.desc: A pull toward a depth that is not in the room.

cinder_peck.name: Cinder Peck
cinder_peck.desc: A peck of live coal, still hungry.

kiln_breath.name: Kiln Breath
kiln_breath.desc: Oven-heat coughed in a short plume.

spark_spit.name: Spark Spit
spark_spit.desc: A spat spark that nests in the wound.

stone_nudge.name: Stone Nudge
stone_nudge.desc: A shove of packed earth and grit.

fault_line.name: Fault Line
fault_line.desc: The floor splits a finger-width and bites.

pebble_toss.name: Pebble Toss
pebble_toss.desc: A hard pebble loosed like a tooth.

gust_cut.name: Gust Cut
gust_cut.desc: A blade of wind, thin as a draft under a door.

shear.name: Shear
shear.desc: Air shears in two and takes a strip with it.

wind_nick.name: Wind Nick
wind_nick.desc: A nick from a passing gust.

thunder_tap.name: Thunder Tap
thunder_tap.desc: Thunder scaled down to a knuckle-rap.

volt_nibble.name: Volt Nibble
volt_nibble.desc: A nibble that leaves the tongue tasting tin.

rime_bite.name: Rime Bite
rime_bite.desc: A bite that leaves the flesh white.

ichor_sip.name: Ichor Sip
ichor_sip.desc: Sips a bright drop and spatters it back.

vein_snap.name: Vein Snap
vein_snap.desc: Snaps a vein-cord like wet string.

clot_flick.name: Clot Flick
clot_flick.desc: A flicked clot, heavy as a pebble.

mind_sting.name: Mind Sting
mind_sting.desc: A sting planted behind the eyes.

trance_pinch.name: Trance Pinch
trance_pinch.desc: A pinch that makes the will go thin.

notion_prick.name: Notion Prick
notion_prick.desc: A prick of someone else's thought.

fang_rush.name: Fang Rush
fang_rush.desc: A rush of old fangs, older than manners.

wild_slam.name: Wild Slam
wild_slam.desc: A slam that remembers being a larger beast.

rot_touch.name: Rot Touch
rot_touch.desc: A touch that unmakes the surface.

mold_bite.name: Mold Bite
mold_bite.desc: A velvet bite that prints its pattern.

glyph_peck.name: Glyph Peck
glyph_peck.desc: A peck that leaves a wet glyph.

hex_nick.name: Hex Nick
hex_nick.desc: A nick from an unfinished hex.

halo_cut.name: Halo Cut
halo_cut.desc: A cut from a thin ring of lantern-light.

null_pinch.name: Null Pinch
null_pinch.desc: A pinch of anti-light, unwriting a speck.

hush_cut.name: Hush Cut
hush_cut.desc: A cut placed in the hush, not the flesh.

void_howl.name: Void Howl
void_howl.desc: A howl from too many angles at once.

storm_crown.name: Storm Crown
storm_crown.desc: The storm worn as a crown comes down.

frost_maw.name: Frost Maw
frost_maw.desc: An ice-maw that frost-welds the wound shut.

rift_aegis.name: Rift Aegis
rift_aegis.desc: A pane of first light, then a shove.

abyssal_bite.name: Abyssal Bite
abyssal_bite.desc: A bite from a depth that is not in the room.

spore_plague.name: Spore Plague
spore_plague.desc: Fruiting bodies open like many mouths.

bind_knot.name: Bind Knot
bind_knot.desc: The first knot pulls taut around the foe.

rift_heart.name: Rift Heart
rift_heart.desc: The burning hole in the world leans closer.

threnody.name: Threnody
threnody.desc: A hymn with teeth. Something is given up.
